facts.fact: Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center at 8:32 a.m. EST on July 16, 1969.
The spacecraft entered lunar orbit at approximately 76 hours ground elapsed time.
The lunar module landed in the Sea of Tranquility at 102:45:40 ground elapsed time.
Armstrong first contacted the lunar surface at 109:24:15 ground elapsed time, 9:56:15 p.m. EST on July 20, 1969.
The ascent stage lifted off at about 124.25 hours and the spacecraft docked at 128 hours ground elapsed time.
The command module landed in the Pacific at about 195.25 hours, and the crew was recovered to USS Hornet.
